core.sealed helpers and tests preserve historical rules; no real seed/read-ledger access or transactional concurrent disclosure service is asserted

connections.history and in-memory handles retain scoped identity, receipt and accounting semantics; no durable owner-operation ledger, receiver fencing, reservation lifecycle or settlement protocol is implemented

connections.evidence capture/selectors establish captured identity within reader scope, not actual native input consumption or general filesystem isolation
experiments.information checks supplied channels/presentations rather than proving complete actual information confinement

connections.ports supplied invocation can return Op rejected after executor entry with invocation_or_ack_failed; it does not establish native absence
connections.ports.attached_connection observes a caller-established handle; no built-in network lookup, fresh attachment authority or attach-or-create fallback is supplied
connections.services.HandleRegistry is in-memory and reconnect reuses an existing handle; durable association reconstruction and controlled handle replacement remain unbuilt
S1 NativeIdentity is a closed authority/namespace/native_id/source object; richer incarnation evidence needs explicit reviewed scope without changing historical wire records
The deterministic s1_native_fixture demonstrates local protocol distinctions, not provider idempotency or post-crash remote reconnection
S1 Cursor and ObservationBatch are runtime representations; no durable cursor/capture/acknowledgement protocol or generic continuity/watermark interpretation is implemented
S1 observe wrappers bound returned record count and serialized record bytes; deadline, driver duration, sink size, source cursor validity and native completeness are not established by those checks
S1 event ordering and immutable record checks do not themselves correlate duplicate native events across transports or adjudicate all temporal/gap semantics
S2 record_decision retains/checks a particular supplied threshold-action policy and exposure basis; no generic policy engine, automatic response delivery or distributed decision claim is supplied
A one-use in-memory delivery grant and local decision record do not establish receiver idempotency or exactly one native response across coordinator restarts
S1 recovery/state_load checks represent and check supplied continuation/load evidence; they do not operate restoration drivers, admit retries or establish actual complete hidden-state continuity
S1 cancellation checks distinguish acknowledged requests from supplied native-stop evidence; no generic escalation or descendant-termination protocol is implemented
S1 accounting_total supports selected unrevised disjoint compatible nonnegative quantities, rejects inclusive overlap and s1.duration sums, and is not a generic metering/settlement ledger
S2 preserves fixed trial intent, supplied recovery lineage/exposure and missingness; it does not automatically retry, choose last/best outputs or reset budgets
S1/S2 roots do not automatically project away other staged records; current package writers/stores do not implement complete audience-specific redaction or transitive disclosure enforcement

PackageStore writes immutable records before its manifest; per-file atomic/fsync/conflict checks do not establish all-or-none multi-file/multi-store commit, universal power-loss durability or adversarial tamper protection
PackageStore.select_current compares expected_previous selected value and emits a generation; it does not check an expected generation and cannot detect every A-to-B-to-A intervening update
S2 frozen allocates a fresh package identity per freeze while copied records remain unchanged; it is not a same-bytes retry of an earlier publication operation
Expected byte digests and local timestamps do not themselves establish source authenticity, historical existence time, complete coverage or causal correctness
Existing resolver access is supplied metadata/read scope, not native/runtime publication authority or an automatic remote retrieval/retention service
The consolidated four-case JSON is authored documentary data, not SC-3 wire examples, implemented S3 runtime, executed native receipts or acceptance evidence

HandleRegistry requires its guarded resolved-attempt association; unknown-origin native observation and richer candidate inventories need an explicit S3 profile/mapping rather than fabricated S1 attempts
A fresh runtime context/registry does not revoke old authority or fence native receivers; no new receiver enforcement is implemented by the proposed handle reconstruction
Audience-specific public statements can require private derivation records; existing package roots do not automatically enforce that separation

final_review_recommendations.subject: plan returns a staged immutable command. Caller persists admission_occurrence and transmission_occurrence before corresponding effectful calls. Admission plan/owner IDs are durably recorded before first owner RPC. Same ID with changed binding conflicts; lost reply resumes/reconciles the same occurrence, never silently allocates a new one.

StateComponent.restore_source identifies captured payload or native handle; availability is separately assessed for the actual loader/cutoff/rights. Identity, readable bytes and actual loading do not imply one another. S1 projection records unavailable raw bytes as unknown/NA and reports loss; it cannot disguise provider attestations as state bytes.

command.admission is the construction-time assessment, possibly unresolved. Later immutable admission assessments/owner receipts reference the command and admission occurrence; current authority comes from live checked owner capabilities, never mutation of C or deserialization of old grants.

commit_capture transaction key equals batch_occurrence; prepare_issue transaction key equals D. A lost transaction ACK is queried by original key and exact binding before cursor advance/new forwarding. Only the first definitely committed D claim receives a live one-time permit; replay, lookup, restart and uncertain commits receive none. A negative native query permits retry only with established closure of old acceptance paths or valid receiver deduplication covering all still-eligible arrivals.

Initial local SQLite rollback journal plus immutable artifact store is qualified only for cooperative same-host processes and tested process crashes. No shared/network path, hostile writer, power-loss, distributed or external native enforcement claim.

Retrospective v2 archives remain preservation fixtures. Independently specified new positive S2-bound executions and receiver-side failure oracles are mandatory before execution support can pass; never fabricate historical identities/bindings.
New tests use test_audit_execution_*.py to match current discovery; gate must prove every mandatory new case was collected and executed without skips.

Opaque runtime credentials can use owner-approved native transport, but never audit serialization/logging. Restricted raw diagnostics stay restricted or explicitly uncaptured; redacted diagnostics are derived evidence, never substituted original bytes.

S3 reads pinned S1/S2 packages; existing S1/S2 readers are not expanded to S3 dialect. Return frozen S1 evidence and existing S2 receipts under explicit bridges; unsupported rich projection keeps loss/withheld claims.
Release receipts separate offline framework conformance, recorded-data parity, actual host matrix and native backend qualification. Skips/not-run/unsupported never become native success.
